claims.quote: It was found that the aberrant levels of glutamate receptors, including EAAT2, GRIN1, GRIN2B, and GRM1, as well as of other glutamatergic pathway-involving proteins, including CAMKK2, PSD95, and nNOS, were significantly regulated in the ischemic cortex.
In the hippocampus, EAAT2, GRIN1, nNOS, and CAM were significantly regulated.
